description: This file defines an internal interface 'IActivationRebalancerMonitor' within the Orleans project, specifically related to placement rebalancing. It includes a static readonly property for reporting period and a method for reporting rebalancing status.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: An internal interface for monitoring activation rebalancing, extending ISystemTarget and IActivationRebalancer, with a reporting method and a reporting period property.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked periodically by the rebalancer worker to report rebalancing status.
